name: sims
description: A simple and intuitive web application designed to help you easily track student collections for specific events. Built with a modern tech stack for a seamless and responsive user experience, this app ensures efficient tracking and management.

scripts.dev-all: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "mongod --dbpath ./data/db" --names "server,client,mongodb"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install
scripts.check-build: npm run check:ts --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dist: npm run build:client && npm run build:server && electron-builder
